description: Scores a page out of 100 on 14 published checks: indexable, title and description, one H1, question headings, direct first-sentence answers, structured data, dates, a named author, lists and tables, source links, specific figures, length, declared language and stock AI phrasing. Returns each check's points, what it found and the fix, ordered by points available. Free, no key. Docs: https://aeolookup.com/aeo-tools/answer-readiness-checker/

url.description: The page or site to check, for example https://example.co.uk/ (https:// is added if missing).
